M50T.matching_method: Main and DM files have equal row counts per cell and are matched by row position (RPT index); verified that DM SoH equals C/10-capacity/initial C/10-capacity (max |diff| in alignment_check).
M50T.units_note: DM values are fractions of initial (x100 for %). R_growth = R(0.1 s)/R(RPT0)-1; R exists only on about half the RPTs.

closure.caveat: DM are model estimates from a half-cell OCV fit that is itself constrained to reproduce the measured capacity; capacity 'closure' is therefore partly by construction and not an independent test.

4000.note: condition level n=6 (T x window): too few for significance; cell level n=17 (cells with a value at this throughput).

6600.note: condition level n=6 (T x window): too few for significance; cell level n=17 (cells with a value at this throughput).

resistance_vs_modes.caveat: Points within a cell are serially correlated and all indicators rise with throughput, so pooled rho overstates independent evidence; partial rank correlation given throughput removes the common trend (cells still pooled).

datasetB.what_it_is: extracted_degradation_metrics.xlsx: 48 cells (F0001..F0155 ids), 6 temperatures (0/10/25/30/45/55 C) x 4 C-rates (0.5/0.75/1.0/1.5), 2 replicates each; columns CF, dR_dch, dR_ch, LLI, LAMpe, LAMne, RMSE. No readme/units in the file: chemistry, cell model, charge/discharge definition of 'c-rate', cycle count and the units of CF/LLI/LAM are NOT stated (catalog note: Zenodo 15755725 short-term ageing study, 'commercial lithium-ion cells'). Values look like percent (LLI 0.5-7). dR_* are mostly negative (resistance decreased?) - sign convention unverified. One LAMne is ~1e-14 (fit bound).

KIT.cyc_condition_codes_inferred: 0 = non-cycling/other (rest, conditioning; no CE; mostly discharge/charge fragments around tests), 1 = ageing cycles (present only in age_type 2 cycle cells; CE reported on discharge rows as Q_dis / preceding Q_chg, verified by hand on P045), 2 = check-up cycles (full-capacity C/3 charge/discharge; ~29 per cell). Profile cells (age_type 3, WLTP) have no CE in cond 1; calendar cells (age_type 1) have no ageing cycles. Inferred from data, not from documentation.
KIT.ce_trim_rule: half-cycles with |1-CE|>2% dropped; cell value needs >=5 remaining ageing cycles with efc<=x*

pulse_r_changes_with_ageing.conclusion: r_ref_10ms/1s are measured per pulse block (not fixed references): they differ block to block and change with ageing.

pulse_step_vs_r_ref_check.note: crude plausibility check only: dV/dI across first current step sample (sample timing unknown); r_ref values were NOT independently recomputed.

KIT.pulse_temperature_note: RT pulse blocks (is_rt=1; cyc_charged=1) used; median measured T = 25.08 C (min 22.1, max 27.8), so R is compared at ~25 C for all ageing temperatures.

S1_plating_cycle_efc60.rule: supported = all 4 criteria true; partially = 2-3; not supported = 0-1. Effects are 1.67C-vs-0.33C charge at fixed 1C discharge, same T and voltage window (and 1.0C-vs-0.33C in pairs).

S1_plating_cycle_efc400.rule: supported = all 4 criteria true; partially = 2-3; not supported = 0-1. Effects are 1.67C-vs-0.33C charge at fixed 1C discharge, same T and voltage window (and 1.0C-vs-0.33C in pairs).

S2_SEI_calendar_day300.rule: supported = T and SOC each raise both cap loss and R10 (rho>0.3) and cap-loss~R10 rho>0.5; partially = 1-2 of 3.

S2_SEI_calendar_day440.rule: supported = T and SOC each raise both cap loss and R10 (rho>0.3) and cap-loss~R10 rho>0.5; partially = 1-2 of 3.

S3_deepDoD_cycle_efc60.verdict: direction supported (R and capacity loss larger at deeper DoD at equal EFC); LAM attribution NOT testable (no OCV/ICA/DVA)
S3_deepDoD_cycle_efc60.confound: windows differ in more than DoD (lower cutoff 2.5 V vs 3.249 V; upper 4.2 vs 4.092 V -> SOC level / voltage stress), so DoD is not isolated.

S3_deepDoD_cycle_efc400.verdict: direction supported (R and capacity loss larger at deeper DoD at equal EFC); LAM attribution NOT testable (no OCV/ICA/DVA)
S3_deepDoD_cycle_efc400.confound: windows differ in more than DoD (lower cutoff 2.5 V vs 3.249 V; upper 4.2 vs 4.092 V -> SOC level / voltage stress), so DoD is not isolated.

lboro_feasibility.folder: data/lboro_calendar_tempvar_26870248 (LG M50LT, 28 cell folders, 20 RPT subfolders + Initial/Final)
lboro_feasibility.not_done: No data files read or computed in this task; zip not touched (already extracted to Test_data_x).
findings: Voltage_profile_fitting_*.m fits a half-cell model (OCP_LGM50LT.mat) to C/24 discharge curves of the INITIAL and FINAL tests only -> LLI/LAM_PE/LAM_NE at two time points per cell (BoL, EoT), not per RPT.
Per-RPT data: Capacity_test.txt, EIS_0.txt and EIS_100.txt (EIS at 0 and 100 % SOC), so capacity + EIS trend per RPT is available.
Conditions per Readme/scripts: storage 25/50 C with variable fraction of time at 50 C, SOC 50/100 %; cells 17 and 22 flagged as missing in a script comment.
lboro_feasibility.feasibility: Feasible but requires porting MATLAB fitting (fmincon + GlobalSearch) to Python/scipy and parsing Autolab text files; gives calendar-only DM at end of test (2 points/cell, ~26 cells) plus EIS growth per RPT. It would add one independent DM-vs-EIS check for calendar ageing, but it is a different chemistry/cell (M50LT) and a thermal-cycling design, so it is a side-check, not a replacement for KIT calendar data.
